messages.subject: make ENTER act like TAB
parts:
Hi all,

How do I make ENTER act like TAB, i.e. when user presses ENTER, the custom TextInput should lose focus and the next element receives focus, just as if TAB were pressed?

Best, Wilbert

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: make ENTER act like TAB
parts:
You'll need to set up your own JS to do that. Something like this?

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$script(HTML("
    $(document).on('shiny:connected', function() {
      $('body').on('keydown', 'input', function(e) {

        // the keyCode for ENTER is 13
        if (e.keyCode == 13) {

          var $current = $(this).parent('div');

          // find the next input
          var $next = $current.next('.form-group.shiny-input-container').find('input');
          
          // or if you're at the end of the document go back to the first one
          if ($next.length === 0) {
            $next = $('.form-group.shiny-input-container input').first(); 
          }

          // if there is a 'next' element, focus it
          if ($next.length) $next.focus(); 

          return false;            
        }
      });
    });
    "))),
  textInput("a", "a"),
  textInput("b", "b"),
  textInput("c", "c")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {}
shinyApp(ui, server)
